# ELN fixtures

Two example `.eln` files from [TheELNConsortium/TheELNFileFormat](https://github.com/TheELNConsortium/TheELNFileFormat) (MIT License, © 2022 The ELN Consortium), copied unchanged from `examples/kadi4mat/records-example.eln` and `examples/PASTA/PASTA.eln` in that repository. They are real exports from Kadi4Mat and PASTA.

`test/eln.test.ts` reads them to check that another notebook's file comes in as runs with their files hashed. [docs/scholarly.md](../../../docs/scholarly.md#reading-a-crate) says what an entry becomes.
